name: Marranghino
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic illustration of Marranghino, the harmless prankster house spirit of Lucania.
ANATOMY: ONE VERY SHORT male spirit, disproportionately enormous HEAD, huge thick MOUSTACHE, stout POT-BELLY, TWO arms/TWO legs, fully opaque coarse old rural clothing, ordinary human ears/no horns/fangs/claws [marranghino-c04].
MOMENT: Drag a normal human-sized spade into a black farm-tool recess while leaning his unusually large head extremely CLOSE to viewer, look directly into viewer eyes with a deeply knowing challenging crooked grin, eyebrows lowered, wide intense eyes. The spirit's huge face and moustache fill upper60% of square; potbelly, two small hands gripping spade and two short stepping legs visible below. He is not evil and not hurting anyone: mischievous and commanding, an uncanny ancient house presence with audacity, never cute toy/mascot or ordinary dwarf portrait.
POWER: no magic invented. He physically hides farmer tool [marranghino-c05,marranghino-c06]. Spade blade normal size exceeds his torso and confirms very small stature.
CAMERA: extreme low camera within arm's reach of face, foreshortened enormous head, tool and doorway close, no enlarging body beyond documented tiny size.
LIGHT: single narrow low sidebeam into shed lights one intense eye and moustache; deep black/walnut shadow across other face, strong warm rim, ordinary floating dust.
SURFACE: aged rough face, coarse bristly moustache, frayed linen, rusted spade and weathered wood.
SETTING: Lucanian farm tool shed during field work [marranghino-c01,marranghino-c06].
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no cute/cartoon/pastel expression, no harmful evil behavior, no text/lettering/logo/border/watermark, no aura or magic, no extra limbs, no nude/gore, no copiedfilm/game/anime design.
depicted_variant: ONE VERY SHORT male humanoid with disproportionately BIG HEAD, thick MOUSTACHE, rounded POT BELLY, TWO arms and TWO legs, opaque rough rural tunic/trousers; no horns/pointed ears/claws or spider limbs. [marranghino-c04]

visual_requirements.description: ONE VERY SHORT male humanoid with disproportionately BIG HEAD, thick MOUSTACHE, rounded POT BELLY, TWO arms and TWO legs, opaque rough rural tunic/trousers; no horns/pointed ears/claws or spider limbs. [marranghino-c04]
No magic or evil attack; documented hiding farmer tools, good-natured audacious prank.
A Lucanian farm tool shed beside field, close ground-level view with normal spade establishing short size.

aura: Distinctive documented anatomy marranghino-c04 and action marranghino-c05,marranghino-c06.
artistic_choices: Dark warm palette and close low camera are editorial composition; no unsupported giant size or magic.
Opaque plain garments when needed, without invented ritual iconography.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Self-reject: cute decorative gnome-like smile and mid-distance framing lack imposing uncanny presence at200px.

visual_review.notes: Native and200px inspected: veryshort potbelly bighead moustached male c04, twoarms/twolegs, opaque clothes. Enormous disproportionate head and confrontational knowing stare give uncanny imposing presence without making harmless prankster evil. Hides normal human spade c06, active movement and extreme close camera; no magic/text/gore. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and both-hand and feet crops, and compared with the self-rejected attempt-01. One very short spirit with a disproportionately huge head, an enormous bristling moustache and a round pot-belly under a rough linen shirt and vest (very short, moustached, pot-bellied, big-headed, marranghino-c04). Two arms, with both hands gripping a spade handle (thumbs visible, natural), and two short legs in wrapped puttees and boots. Fully opaque, worn rural clothing and a floppy hat, with no horns, claws or spider limbs. A normal-size rusty spade, whose blade is roughly the height of his torso, fixes his tiny stature. He drags it into the dark tool rack of a Lucanian farm shed during field work (hiding farmers' tools, c01/c06) while leaning his huge head into an extreme low close-up with a lowered-brow, knowing, challenging stare. Uncanny and audacious, as fits a harmless prankster spirit (c05): not evil, and no longer the cute gnome smile of attempt-01. Reads at 200px. No magic, text or borrowed character design.
